grammatica.evidence: Imperative fragments + markdown checkbox lines ('Empty and bleach…', 'Order vermiculite — two bags, not one'); stock ops-checklist register; notes as longer compounds.

dialectica.evidence: Contingency: 'If the glazier slips past planting week, move the window-row basil to row 2…'; min-gap justified 'it saved the cucurbits twice' — neither follows from general literacy.

rhetorica.evidence: Order Before seed order → Planting week → Blocked → Notes; keep [x] items visible; elevate 'Do not top-water' as [!] and waits as [>] out of ordinary [ ] todos.

arithmetica.evidence: Atomic states: r5–6 bleached done; drip coupler [/]; vermiculite two bags; basil window-only; pane→glazier; relay parts Thursday; min-gap one empty cell — current-work facts.

geometria.evidence: YAML frontmatter; H1; Goal line; three H2 checklist chunks + Notes prose; flat - [state] lists — shape chosen to surface next vs blocked.

musica.evidence: Staccato parallel checklist lines; single stressed prohibition '[!] Do not top-water…'; Notes cadence with colon and trailing clause.

astronomia.evidence: Arc: goal → prep with mixed [x]/[/]/[ ] → planting rules + ban → external [>] blocks → fallback Notes; paced so next work and blockers read in one pass.

notes: Context substrate: operational shared knowledge only; no corpus lookup. Nonstandard checkbox glyphs ([/],[!],[>]) treated as local form, not public stock.
